methods.summary: Declares a schema you can hoist out of `defineSubgraph()` and reuse.
methods.description:
Declares a schema you can hoist out of `defineSubgraph()` and reuse.

It keeps the schema's literal types, so table names and row columns stay
checked in helpers typed `TypedSubgraphContext<typeof schema>`. `as const`
alone does not work: it produces `readonly` arrays that a mutable
`uniqueKeys` rejects, and a bare literal widens `type` to `string`.

methods.summary: Declares a subgraph and keeps its source and schema literal types.
methods.description:
Declares a subgraph and keeps its source and schema literal types.

Handlers are typed per source, and the schema drives query-client inference.
It returns its argument unchanged.

methods.summary: Lists the fields each source filter type accepts.
methods.description:
Lists the fields each source filter type accepts.

The list is derived from `SubgraphFilterSchema`. Agent-facing surfaces
such as the MCP filters reference used to keep a parallel copy by hand;
deriving it means adding a field to a filter can never leave the
documentation behind.

methods.summary: Validates a subgraph definition and returns the parsed result.
methods.description:
Validates a subgraph definition and returns the parsed result.

It throws when the definition is invalid.

methods.summary: Camelizes object keys recursively, the way print payloads are.
methods.description:
Camelizes object keys recursively, the way print payloads are.

It uses the print-payload helper, not ABI `toCamelCase`, which strips `-STX`
and prefixes leading digits.

methods.summary: Infers per-topic field schemas from sampled print events.
methods.description:
Infers per-topic field schemas from sampled print events. Counts and
height bounds cover ALL rows of a topic (cheap); only a bounded subset is
deserialized for typing. Rows with missing/undecodable hex still count but
contribute nothing to typing.

fields.name: contractId
fields.description:
One contract id, or a SET of them (max 20) — the standard DeFi shape is
a router plus N pools, which used to cost N near-identical sources and
handlers. Payload types are identical per `type`, so one handler serves
the set and `event.contractId` disambiguates.

Supports `*` wildcards (e.g. `"SP1ABC….pool-*"`). Mutually exclusive
with `trait`, which resolves its own set per block.

fields.name: abi
fields.description:
Contract ABI (pass it `as const`) used to type `event.input` — the named,
decoded function arguments. Dev-provided; serialized into the deployed
definition and used at runtime to decode args by name. Omit to keep
`event.args` as a positional `unknown[]`.

Required whenever `functionName` is set. `secondlayer subgraphs deploy`
fills it in from the deployed contract for a single concrete
`contractId`; pass it yourself for wildcard, multi-contract or trait
sources, or a local deploy (`normalizeAbi()` from
`@secondlayer/stacks/clarity`).

Nested tuples and lists never match.

fields.name: client
fields.description:
Read-only contract calls pinned to this block. Cached, so the same
(contract, function, args) is fetched once per block rather than once
per event.

Erased here on purpose: this interface is compared structurally wherever
a subgraph definition is passed around, and carrying an ABI-generic
method pushes those comparisons past TS's instantiation depth. Handlers
receive `TypedSubgraphContext`, which exposes the fully typed version.

fields.name: increment
fields.type: (table: string, key: Record<string, unknown>, deltas: Record<string, number | bigint>) => void
fields.description:
Atomic counter update — the blessed accumulator primitive. Applies
`col = COALESCE(col, 0) + delta` per column (insert-or-add); deltas may
be negative. Requires a uniqueKeys constraint matching `key`. Prefer
this over read-modify-write handlers for running totals.
